title: rustfs/rustfs
title_zh: 高性能Rust构建对象存储系统

paragraphs.en: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.
paragraphs.zh: RustFS 是一个开源的、兼容 S3 的高性能对象存储系统，支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等其他兼容 S3 的平台进行迁移和共存。

paragraphs.en: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust.
paragraphs.zh: RustFS 是一个用 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统。

paragraphs.en: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust—one of the most loved programming languages worldwide. RustFS combines the simplicity of MinIO with the memory safety and raw performance of Rust. It offers broad S3 API compatibility for supported features, is completely open-source, and is optimized for data lakes, AI, and big data workloads.
paragraphs.zh: RustFS 是一个用 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统——Rust 是全球最受欢迎的编程语言之一。 RustFS 将 MinIO 的简洁性与 Rust 的内存安全性和卓越性能相结合。 它对所支持的功能提供广泛的 S3 API 兼容性，完全开源，并针对数据湖、AI 和大数据工作负载进行了优化。

paragraphs.en: Unlike other storage systems, RustFS is released under the permissible Apache 2.0 license, avoiding the restrictions of AGPL. With Rust as its foundation, RustFS delivers superior speed and secure distributed features for next-generation object storage.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他存储系统不同，RustFS 采用宽松的 Apache 2.0 许可证发布，避免了 AGPL 的限制。 以 Rust 为基础，RustFS 为下一代对象存储提供了卓越的速度和安全的分布式特性。

paragraphs.en: To get started with RustFS, follow these steps:
paragraphs.zh: 要开始使用 RustFS，请按照以下步骤操作：

paragraphs.en: curl -O https://rustfs.com/install_rustfs.sh && bash install_rustfs.sh 2. Docker Quick Start (Option 2) The RustFS container runs as a non-root user rustfs (UID/GID 10001:10001 ). If you bind-mount host directories with Docker or Compose, every mounted path must be writable by that user, otherwise startup may fail with permission denied errors. This applies to data directories, log directories, and TLS certificate directories when RUSTFS_TLS_PATH is enabled.
paragraphs.zh: curl -O https://rustfs.com/install_rustfs.sh && bash install_rustfs.sh 2. Docker 快速入门（选项 2）RustFS 容器以非 root 用户 rustfs（UID/GID 10001:10001）运行。 如果你使用 Docker 或 Compose 绑定挂载主机目录，则每个被挂载的路径都必须对该用户可写，否则启动时可能会因权限被拒绝而失败。 当启用 RUSTFS_TLS_PATH 时，这同样适用于数据目录、日志目录和 TLS 证书目录。

sents.en: curl -O https://rustfs.com/install_rustfs.sh && bash install_rustfs.sh 2.
sents.zh: curl -O https://rustfs.com/install_rustfs.sh && bash install_rustfs.sh 2.

sents.en: Docker Quick Start (Option 2) The RustFS container runs as a non-root user rustfs (UID/GID 10001:10001 ).
sents.zh: Docker 快速入门（选项 2）RustFS 容器以非 root 用户 rustfs（UID/GID 10001:10001）运行。

sents.en: If you bind-mount host directories with Docker or Compose, every mounted path must be writable by that user, otherwise startup may fail with permission denied errors.
sents.zh: 如果你使用 Docker 或 Compose 绑定挂载主机目录，则每个被挂载的路径都必须对该用户可写，否则启动时可能会因权限被拒绝而失败。

sents.en: This applies to data directories, log directories, and TLS certificate directories when RUSTFS_TLS_PATH is enabled.
sents.zh: 当启用 RUSTFS_TLS_PATH 时，这同样适用于数据目录、日志目录和 TLS 证书目录。

paragraphs.en: # Create data and logs directories mkdir -p data logs # Change the owner of these directories chown -R 10001:10001 data logs # Using latest version docker run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs rustfs/rustfs:latest # Using specific version docker run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs rustfs/rustfs:1.0.3 If you use podman instead of docker, you can install the RustFS with the below command
paragraphs.zh: # 创建数据和日志目录 mkdir -p data logs # 更改这些目录的所有者 chown -R 10001:10001 data logs # 使用最新版本 docker run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs rustfs/rustfs:latest # 使用特定版本 docker run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs rustfs/rustfs:1.0.3 如果你使用 podman 而不是 docker，可以通过以下命令安装 RustFS

paragraphs.en: # Create data and logs directories mkdir -p data logs # Run the container (podman will automatically set the folders ownership) podman run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data:Z,U -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs:Z,U rustfs/rustfs:latest If you enable TLS with a bind-mounted certificate directory, prepare that mount the same way:
paragraphs.zh: # 创建数据和日志目录 mkdir -p data logs # 运行容器（podman 会自动设置文件夹的所有权） podman run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v $( pwd ) /data:/data:Z,U -v $( pwd ) /logs:/logs:Z,U rustfs/rustfs:latest 如果您通过绑定挂载的证书目录启用了 TLS，请以相同的方式准备该挂载：

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p certs chown -R 10001:10001 certs You can also use Docker Compose. Using the docker-compose-simple.yml file in the root directory:
paragraphs.zh: mkdir -p certs chown -R 10001:10001 certs 你也可以使用 Docker Compose。 使用根目录中的 docker-compose-simple.yml 文件：

sents.en: mkdir -p certs chown -R 10001:10001 certs You can also use Docker Compose.
sents.zh: mkdir -p certs chown -R 10001:10001 certs 你也可以使用 Docker Compose。

sents.en: Using the docker-compose-simple.yml file in the root directory:
sents.zh: 使用根目录中的 docker-compose-simple.yml 文件：

paragraphs.en: docker compose -f docker-compose-simple.yml up -d Before running Compose with host bind mounts:
paragraphs.zh: docker compose -f docker-compose-simple.yml up -d 在使用主机绑定挂载运行 Compose 之前：

paragraphs.en: Similarly, you can run the command with podman
paragraphs.zh: 同样，你可以使用 podman 运行该命令

paragraphs.en: podman compose -f docker-compose-simple.yml up -d Webhook notification quick start (Docker):
paragraphs.zh: podman compose -f docker-compose-simple.yml up -d Webhook 通知快速入门（Docker）：

paragraphs.en: docker run -d --name rustfs -p 9000:9000 \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_ENABLE=true \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_ENABLE_PRIMARY=on \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_PRIMARY=http:// < host-ip > :3020/webhook \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_QUEUE_DIR_PRIMARY=/tmp/rustfs-events \ -e RUSTFS_OUTBOUND_ALLOW_ORIGINS=http:// < host-ip > :3020 \ rustfs/rustfs:latest Notes:
paragraphs.zh: docker run -d --name rustfs -p 9000:9000 \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_ENABLE=true \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_ENABLE_PRIMARY=on \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_PRIMARY=http://<主机IP>:3020/webhook \ -e RUSTFS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_QUEUE_DIR_PRIMARY=/tmp/rustfs-events \ -e RUSTFS_OUTBOUND_ALLOW_ORIGINS=http://<主机IP>:3020 \ rustfs/rustfs:latest 注意事项：

paragraphs.en: NOTE : We recommend reviewing the docker-compose.yml file before running. It defines several services including Grafana, Prometheus, and Jaeger, which are helpful for RustFS observability. If you wish to start Redis or Nginx containers, you can specify the corresponding profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：我们建议在运行之前先查看 docker-compose.yml 文件。 它定义了多个服务，包括 Grafana、Prometheus 和 Jaeger，这些服务有助于 RustFS 的可观测性。 如果您希望启动 Redis 或 Nginx 容器，可以指定相应的 profile。

paragraphs.en: For developers who want to build RustFS Docker images from source with multi-architecture support:
paragraphs.zh: 对于希望从源码构建支持多架构的 RustFS Docker 镜像的开发者：

paragraphs.en: # Build multi-architecture images locally ./docker-buildx.sh # Build a single-platform image locally ./docker-buildx.sh -p linux/amd64 # Build and push to registry ./docker-buildx.sh --push # Build specific version ./docker-buildx.sh --release 1.0.3 --push # Build for custom registry ./docker-buildx.sh --registry your-registry.com --namespace yourname --push The docker-buildx.sh script supports:
paragraphs.zh: # 本地构建多架构镜像 ./docker-buildx.sh # 本地构建单平台镜像 ./docker-buildx.sh -p linux/amd64 # 构建并推送到镜像仓库 ./docker-buildx.sh --push # 构建指定版本 ./docker-buildx.sh --release 1.0.3 --push # 为自定义镜像仓库构建 ./docker-buildx.sh --registry your-registry.com --namespace yourname --push docker-buildx.sh 脚本支持：

paragraphs.en: You can also use Make targets for convenience:
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以使用 Make 目标来提升便利性：

paragraphs.en: make docker-buildx # Build locally make docker-buildx-push # Build and push make docker-buildx-version VERSION=1.0.3 # Build specific version make help-docker # Show all Docker-related commands Heads-up (macOS cross-compilation) : macOS keeps the default ulimit -n at 256, so cargo zigbuild or ./build-rustfs.sh --platform ... may fail with ProcessFdQuotaExceeded when targeting Linux. The build script attempts to raise the limit automatically, but if you still see the warning, run ulimit -n 4096 (or higher) in your shell before building.
paragraphs.zh: make docker-buildx # 本地构建 make docker-buildx-push # 构建并推送 make docker-buildx-version VERSION=1.0.3 # 构建指定版本 make help-docker # 显示所有 Docker 相关命令 注意（macOS 交叉编译）：macOS 将默认的 ulimit -n 保持为 256，因此在面向 Linux 构建时，cargo zigbuild 或 ./build-rustfs.sh --platform ... 可能会因 ProcessFdQuotaExceeded 而失败。 构建脚本会尝试自动提高该限制，但如果仍然看到警告，请在构建前于你的 shell 中运行 ulimit -n 4096（或更高的值）。

sents.en: make docker-buildx # Build locally make docker-buildx-push # Build and push make docker-buildx-version VERSION=1.0.3 # Build specific version make help-docker # Show all Docker-related commands Heads-up (macOS cross-compilation) : macOS keeps the default ulimit -n at 256, so cargo zigbuild or ./build-rustfs.sh --platform ... may fail with ProcessFdQuotaExceeded when targeting Linux.
sents.zh: make docker-buildx # 本地构建 make docker-buildx-push # 构建并推送 make docker-buildx-version VERSION=1.0.3 # 构建指定版本 make help-docker # 显示所有 Docker 相关命令 注意（macOS 交叉编译）：macOS 将默认的 ulimit -n 保持为 256，因此在面向 Linux 构建时，cargo zigbuild 或 ./build-rustfs.sh --platform ... 可能会因 ProcessFdQuotaExceeded 而失败。

sents.en: The build script attempts to raise the limit automatically, but if you still see the warning, run ulimit -n 4096 (or higher) in your shell before building.
sents.zh: 构建脚本会尝试自动提高该限制，但如果仍然看到警告，请在构建前于你的 shell 中运行 ulimit -n 4096（或更高的值）。

paragraphs.en: Follow the instructions in the Helm Chart README to install RustFS on a Kubernetes cluster.
paragraphs.zh: 按照 Helm Chart README 中的说明，在 Kubernetes 集群上安装 RustFS。

paragraphs.en: # Run directly without installing nix run github:rustfs/rustfs # Build the binary nix build github:rustfs/rustfs ./result/bin/rustfs --help # Or from a local checkout nix build nix run The flake also exports a NixOS module and the RustFS rc client. Add the module to your system and provide credentials through runtime files (for example, sops-nix or agenix) so secrets are never stored in the Nix store:
paragraphs.zh: # 直接运行而无需安装 nix run github:rustfs/rustfs # 构建二进制文件 nix build github:rustfs/rustfs ./result/bin/rustfs --help # 或者从本地检出构建 nix build nix run 该 flake 还导出了一个 NixOS 模块和 RustFS rc 客户端。 将该模块添加到你的系统中，并通过运行时文件（例如 sops-nix 或 agenix）提供凭据，这样密钥就永远不会存储在 Nix store 中：

sents.en: # Run directly without installing nix run github:rustfs/rustfs # Build the binary nix build github:rustfs/rustfs ./result/bin/rustfs --help # Or from a local checkout nix build nix run The flake also exports a NixOS module and the RustFS rc client.
sents.zh: # 直接运行而无需安装 nix run github:rustfs/rustfs # 构建二进制文件 nix build github:rustfs/rustfs ./result/bin/rustfs --help # 或者从本地检出构建 nix build nix run 该 flake 还导出了一个 NixOS 模块和 RustFS rc 客户端。

sents.en: Add the module to your system and provide credentials through runtime files (for example, sops-nix or agenix) so secrets are never stored in the Nix store:
sents.zh: 将该模块添加到你的系统中，并通过运行时文件（例如 sops-nix 或 agenix）提供凭据，这样密钥就永远不会存储在 Nix store 中：

paragraphs.en: imports = [ inputs . rustfs . nixosModules . rustfs ] ; services . rustfs = { enable = true ; accessKeyFile = "/run/secrets/rustfs-access-key" ; secretKeyFile = "/run/secrets/rustfs-secret-key" ; volumes = [ "/var/lib/rustfs" ] ; } ; Install the S3-compatible client with nix profile install github:rustfs/rustfs#rustfs-client (the executable is named rc ), or use inputs.rustfs.packages.${pkgs.system}.rustfs-client in a system configuration.
paragraphs.zh: imports = [ inputs . rustfs . nixosModules . rustfs ] ; services . rustfs = { enable = true ; accessKeyFile = "/run/secrets/rustfs-access-key" ; secretKeyFile = "/run/secrets/rustfs-secret-key" ; volumes = [ "/var/lib/rustfs" ] ; } ; 使用 nix profile install github:rustfs/rustfs#rustfs-client 安装 S3 兼容客户端（可执行文件名为 rc ），或者在系统配置中使用 inputs.rustfs.packages.${pkgs.system}.rustfs-client。

paragraphs.en: # Run directly without installing x rustfs # Download the binary and install it to the global environment x env use rustfs rustfs --help Accessing RustFS Access the Console : Open your web browser and navigate to http://localhost:9001 to access the RustFS console. Default credentials: rustfsadmin / rustfsadmin Create a Bucket : Use the console to create a new bucket for your objects. Upload Objects : You can upload files directly through the console or use S3-compatible APIs/clients to interact with your RustFS instance. NOTE : To access the RustFS instance via https , please refer to the TLS Configuration Docs .
paragraphs.zh: # 免安装直接运行 x rustfs # 下载二进制文件并安装到全局环境 x env use rustfs rustfs --help 访问 RustFS 访问控制台：打开浏览器并导航到 http://localhost:9001 以访问 RustFS 控制台。 默认凭据：rustfsadmin / rustfsadmin 创建存储桶：使用控制台为你的对象创建一个新的存储桶。 上传对象：你可以直接通过控制台上传文件，或使用兼容 S3 的 API/客户端与你的 RustFS 实例交互。 注意：要通过 https 访问 RustFS 实例，请参阅 TLS 配置文档。

paragraphs.en: RustFS supports mapping an OIDC claim containing role values into the existing authorization pipeline. The roles_claim setting is optional : when unset or empty, only the groups claim contributes to authorization (same as older RustFS releases). For Microsoft Entra ID app roles, set roles_claim=roles so both console admin checks and bucket IAM policies can evaluate those roles.
paragraphs.zh: RustFS 支持将包含角色值的 OIDC 声明映射到现有的授权管道中。 roles_claim 设置是可选的：当未设置或为空时，只有 groups 声明参与授权（与旧版本 RustFS 相同）。 对于 Microsoft Entra ID 应用角色，请设置 roles_claim=roles，这样控制台管理员检查和存储桶 IAM 策略都能评估这些角色。

sents.en: RustFS supports mapping an OIDC claim containing role values into the existing authorization pipeline.
sents.zh: RustFS 支持将包含角色值的 OIDC 声明映射到现有的授权管道中。

sents.en: The roles_claim setting is optional : when unset or empty, only the groups claim contributes to authorization (same as older RustFS releases).
sents.zh: roles_claim 设置是可选的：当未设置或为空时，只有 groups 声明参与授权（与旧版本 RustFS 相同）。

sents.en: For Microsoft Entra ID app roles, set roles_claim=roles so both console admin checks and bucket IAM policies can evaluate those roles.
sents.zh: 对于 Microsoft Entra ID 应用角色，请设置 roles_claim=roles，这样控制台管理员检查和存储桶 IAM 策略都能评估这些角色。

paragraphs.en: Example environment configuration (opt-in roles claim):
paragraphs.zh: 示例环境配置（可选加入角色声明）：

paragraphs.en: RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_ENABLE=on RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CONFIG_URL= " https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CLIENT_ID= " <client-id> " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET= " <client-secret> " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_SCOPES= " openid,profile,email " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_GROUPS_CLAIM= " groups " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_ROLES_CLAIM= " roles " Policy condition example (evaluate app roles directly with jwt:roles ; when roles_claim is configured, RustFS also merges those values into jwt:groups for backward compatibility with older policies):
paragraphs.zh: RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_ENABLE=on RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CONFIG_URL= " https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CLIENT_ID= " <client-id> " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET= " <client-secret> " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_SCOPES= " openid,profile,email " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_GROUPS_CLAIM= " groups " RUSTFS_IDENTITY_OPENID_ROLES_CLAIM= " roles " 策略条件示例（使用 jwt:roles 直接评估应用角色；当配置了 roles_claim 时，RustFS 还会将这些值合并到 jwt:groups 中，以兼容较旧的政策）：

paragraphs.en: { "Version" : " 2012-10-17 " , "Statement" : [ { "Effect" : " Allow " , "Action" : [ " admin:* " ], "Resource" : [ " arn:aws:s3:::* " ], "Condition" : { "ForAnyValue:StringEquals" : { "jwt:roles" : [ " RustFS.ConsoleAdmin " ] } } } ] } Documentation For detailed documentation, including configuration options, API references, and advanced usage, please visit our Documentation .
paragraphs.zh: { "Version" : " 2012-10-17 " , "Statement" : [ { "Effect" : " Allow " , "Action" : [ " admin:* " ], "Resource" : [ " arn:aws:s3:::* " ], "Condition" : { "ForAnyValue:StringEquals" : { "jwt:roles" : [ " RustFS.ConsoleAdmin " ] } } } ] } 文档 有关详细的文档，包括配置选项、API 参考和高级用法，请访问我们的 文档 。
